dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Columbina</color> looks like she has something to say...)

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Maybe I can try to help you with that.

dialogues.speaker: Ina
dialogues.text: Hmm...? Miss, you are...

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: ...Ah! Lauma told us before, you're the one they call Kuutar...

dialogues.speaker: Ina
dialogues.text: Hey, Miss Lauma said her name is Columbina, too.

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: Oh... Oh right! I remember now...

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: (B—But... isn't she our Moon Goddess!?)

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: Umm... you don't have to trouble yourself, Lady Kuu— uh, Miss Columbina... You must be just as busy as Lauma...

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: No. I am not. Lauma handles everything.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: You want to know how the little puffin you looked after is doing, don't you?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Pardon me... Do you know the little puffin Ina and Kari were looking after before?

dialogues.speaker: Puffin
dialogues.text: (Friend, friend! Know, yes! At home! Too long away, danger, danger!)

dialogues.speaker: Puffin
dialogues.text: (Papa, Mama, worried. Papa, Mama, stopped it from leaving!)

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Your guess is right. The little puffin is currently stuck at home, getting an earful from its parents for being away for too long.

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: Wow, you're pretty smart, Ina!

dialogues.speaker: Ina
dialogues.text: Hehe, I've read a lot of books, you know.

dialogues.speaker: Puffin
dialogues.text: (Friend, good! Friend, want to see! Come to home, hurry to home!)

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: ...This puffin says that your friend also misses you.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: It can't go outside right now, but you could... go be its guests instead?

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: Huh? Could we? But I don't even know where it lives...

dialogues.speaker: Ina
dialogues.text: And if we're out of doors for too long, we'll be the ones getting scolded by our parents...

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: It's all right. I know some other friends who might lend a hand too.

dialogues.speaker: Rimehorn Deer
dialogues.text: (Lady Moon Goddess. Allow me to escort the two children. It is not far to go from here — a round trip shall not even take half a day.)

dialogues.speaker: Rimehorn Deer
dialogues.text: (It is no ill deed to help old friends meet again.)

dialogues.speaker: Puffin
dialogues.text: (I'll lead the way! Lead the way! I fly high! I know the shortcuts!)

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: What are they saying, Miss Columbina?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: This puffin is willing to take you to see your friend, and this deer wishes to escort you there and back again.

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: Ohh, that's... that's great! Thank you! And thank you, too!

dialogues.speaker: Puffin
dialogues.text: (Easy-peasy, leave it to me-see!)

dialogues.speaker: Rimehorn Deer
dialogues.text: (Mmm. Of wholesome heart and polite, these children are. Lady Columbina, they shall be safe with us.)

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Then I leave it to you. Lauma keeps many fruits on her table. When you return, I'll share some with you. They're quite sweet.

dialogues.speaker: Rimehorn Deer
dialogues.text: (You are most welcome, Lady Moon Goddess. There is no need for such decorum when aiding family.)

dialogues.speaker: Puffin
dialogues.text: (I wanna eat fruit! So does he! He wants 'em too, but he won't say!)

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: Are we... supposed to get on?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Yes. You can walk with them if you like, but it's a long way. Better to ride.

dialogues.speaker: Ina
dialogues.text: Got it, thank you! Come on, Kari, up we go.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Ina and Kari climb atop the Rimehorn Deer's back. Afterward, the puffin flies up, with the deer following closely. Very quickly, the two people and two animals disappear from sight...

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: ...I wonder what it feels like to ride on a Rimehorn Deer like that. Maybe... I should try it sometime.
